question: How many kilocalories are in one level teaspoon (4 g) of white granulated sugar?
source_title: USDA FoodData Central - Sugars, granulated
explainer: A teaspoon of sugar weighs about 4 g and every gram of sugar carries 4 kcal, so each spoonful in your tea adds roughly 16 kcal.

question: How many grams of sugar are in a 330 ml can of Coca-Cola Original Taste sold in the UK?
source_title: Coca-Cola Great Britain - Coca-Cola Original Taste nutrition
explainer: That is almost nine teaspoons of sugar in one can, more than the 30 g of free sugars per day the UK NHS recommends as an adult's maximum.

question: How many hot dogs and buns did Joey Chestnut eat in 10 minutes to set the Nathan's Famous Fourth of July contest record in 2021?
source_title: Wikipedia - Joey Chestnut
explainer: That is one hot dog every eight seconds for ten minutes; at a 2024 exhibition against Takeru Kobayashi he pushed the all-time mark to 83.

question: How many milligrams of caffeine are in a standard 8 oz (240 ml) cup of brewed coffee, per the Mayo Clinic?
source_title: Mayo Clinic - Caffeine content for coffee, tea, soda and more
explainer: A single shot of espresso has about 64 mg, and the US FDA considers up to 400 mg a day safe for most healthy adults, so about four cups of drip coffee.

question: How many kilocalories are in a McDonald's Big Mac in the US, according to McDonald's own nutrition facts?
source_title: McDonald's USA - Big Mac nutrition
explainer: Add a medium fries (about 320 kcal) and a medium Coke (about 200 kcal) and the meal passes 1,100 kcal, roughly half of an adult's daily energy needs.

question: As of 2025, how many years has Sobrino de Botín in Madrid, the world's oldest continuously operating restaurant, been open?
source_title: Wikipedia - Sobrino de Botín
explainer: Botín opened in 1725 and still roasts suckling pig in its original wood-fired oven; Guinness World Records lists it as the oldest restaurant in continuous operation.

question: How many metres long was the longest pizza ever made, baked in Fontana, California in 2017 (Guinness World Record)?
source_title: Guinness World Records - Longest pizza
explainer: The pizza stretched almost 2 km, about 18 football pitches end to end, and was baked by ovens rolling along a conveyor before being donated to food banks.

question: How many litres of water does it take on average worldwide to produce 1 kg of beef, counting feed, drinking and processing?
source_title: Water Footprint Network - Product water footprint gallery (Mekonnen & Hoekstra)
explainer: Almost all of that water goes into growing cattle feed; by the same method 1 kg of chicken needs about 4,300 litres and 1 kg of wheat about 1,800 litres.

question: How many McDonald's restaurants were operating worldwide at the end of 2024?
source_title: McDonald's Corporation 2024 Annual Report (Form 10-K)
explainer: Roughly 95% of them are run by franchisees across more than 100 countries; the United States alone has around 13,500 McDonald's.

question: How many Starbucks stores were open worldwide at the end of fiscal year 2024 (September 2024)?
source_title: Starbucks Q4 Fiscal Year 2024 Results press release
explainer: Starbucks passed 40,000 stores for the first time in 2024; about 17,000 are in the US and nearly 8,000 in China, its second-largest market.

question: What record price in US dollars did a single bottle of 1945 Romanée-Conti wine fetch at Sotheby's in 2018, the most ever paid?
source_title: Wikipedia - Romanée-Conti
explainer: Only about 600 bottles of the 1945 vintage were made before the old vines were pulled out and replanted, which is why one bottle sold for the price of a house.

question: How many Scoville heat units does Pepper X, certified the world's hottest chili pepper by Guinness in 2023, average?
source_title: Guinness World Records - Hottest chili pepper
explainer: That is several hundred times hotter than a jalapeño (2,500-8,000 SHU) and in the same league as police pepper spray.

question: How many hectares of vineyards were planted worldwide in 2023, according to the OIV?
source_title: OIV - State of the World Vine and Wine Sector in 2023
explainer: That is about the land area of Ireland; Spain, France and China each have roughly 750,000-950,000 hectares under vine.

question: How many tonnes of green coffee beans were produced worldwide in the 2023/24 coffee year, per the ICO?
source_title: International Coffee Organization - Coffee Report and Outlook, December 2023
explainer: That is about 178 million standard 60 kg bags; Brazil grows roughly a third of the world's coffee and Vietnam about a sixth.

question: How many tonnes of wheat were harvested worldwide in the 2023/24 season?
source_title: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service - Grain: World Markets and Trade
explainer: That works out to almost 100 kg of wheat for every person on Earth; China, India, Russia and the EU together grow about half of it.

question: How many hot dogs do Americans eat on the Fourth of July, according to the National Hot Dog and Sausage Council?
source_title: National Hot Dog and Sausage Council - Hot dog consumption statistics
explainer: Laid end to end, 150 million hot dogs would stretch from Washington, DC to Los Angeles more than five times over.

question: How many tonnes of food did households, food service and retail waste worldwide in 2022, per the UNEP Food Waste Index?
source_title: UNEP Food Waste Index Report 2024
explainer: That is about 132 kg per person per year, roughly a fifth of all food available to consumers; households alone account for about 60% of it.

question: What was McDonald's Corporation's total revenue in 2024, in US dollars?
source_title: McDonald's Corporation 2024 Annual Report (Form 10-K)
explainer: Most of that is rent and royalties from franchisees rather than burger sales; systemwide sales across all McDonald's restaurants were about US$130 billion.

question: How many litres of wine were produced worldwide in 2023, according to the OIV?
source_title: OIV - State of the World Vine and Wine Sector in 2023
explainer: At 237 million hectolitres it was the smallest harvest since 1961, hit by drought and frost, yet still enough for about 32 billion 750 ml bottles.

question: How many litres of beer were brewed worldwide in 2023, according to the BarthHaas hop report?
source_title: BarthHaas Report Hops 2023/2024
explainer: That is 1.88 billion hectolitres, around 23 litres for every person alive; China, the United States and Brazil are the three biggest brewing nations.

question: How many servings of instant noodles were eaten worldwide in 2023, according to the World Instant Noodles Association?
source_title: World Instant Noodles Association - Global demand for instant noodles
explainer: China and Hong Kong alone account for about 42 billion servings; worldwide it works out to roughly 15 packets per person per year.

question: How much was spent on food in the United States in 2023, at home and away from home combined, in US dollars (USDA ERS)?
source_title: USDA Economic Research Service - Food Prices and Spending
explainer: More than half of it went to food away from home, meaning restaurants, takeaway and cafeterias, rather than groceries; that is roughly US$7,700 per American.

question: How many servings of Coca-Cola Company beverages are consumed worldwide every day, according to the company (as of 2024)?
source_title: The Coca-Cola Company - About us
explainer: That is more than one serving a day for every four people on Earth, spread across the company's 200-plus brands from Coke to Fanta, Sprite and bottled water.
